purpose: Control the transition composer_decision -> draft_session -> validated_session -> staged_release -> published_release with fail-closed QA, readback and rollback.

inputs.current_publication_snapshot: Current known-good remote publication/version used as rollback anchor.

concepts: Every concept has a concise main layer and a supportDetails layer that adds information rather than paraphrasing.

supportDetails should include, when applicable: core, intuition, mechanism/why, identify, guided example, contrast/commonError, trap, useful connection, discipline-specific checklist and microcheck/transfer.
Examples must be concept-specific; placeholders are forbidden.
Checklists must be discipline/type specific; generic reused checklists are forbidden.
qualityContract.visuals: Use an informative visual/code/table/flow/diagram when the concept materially benefits from one; decorative visuals do not satisfy this requirement.
questions: Every fixation/final question has a validated correct alternative and plausible distractors.
Every question explains why the correct option is correct; final questions explain relevant distractor errors when useful.
Real/FGV attribution requires verified provenance; adapted items must be explicitly labelled; authorial items must be labelled authorial/FGV-style.
structure: Unique IDs across concepts and questions.
Coverage IDs exist and are validated.
Source IDs exist and provenance is valid.
Question counts and JSON structure match the declared session contract.
Mobile QA passes without answer leakage or horizontal-scroll blockers.

publicationRules: Publication is atomic for the single session/release package.
Never point Sessoes_Publicacoes/Config to an incomplete remote version.
A staged release must be read back and checksum-matched before publish is allowed.
A published release must be read back and checksum-matched before success is recorded.
Any failed publish/readback triggers rollback to the previously verified publication snapshot.
Rollback failure is a hard operational error requiring explicit notification.
No gate may mutate learner history, prior session progress or mastery.
